name: Shin Seizonritsu 0%! Chikatetsu Kara no Dasshutsu
original_name: 新･生存率0％！地下鉄からの脱出
source:
Midnight Subway. 14 strangers board in to the last train with their own reasons. However, as the train keeps on running, it actually led them to their despair..

One person took another's life.

「The culprit is one of us here?!」

With fear, will you be able to escape the subway of death?
translation: 午夜地铁。14名陌生人因各自的理由登上末班车。然而列车持续行驶，竟将他们带向绝望。有人杀死了另一个人。“凶手就在我们当中？！”面对恐惧，你能逃离死亡地铁吗？
